Based on our current assessment, approximately $351.6 million in assets were affected. Bitget’s cold wallets and the overwhelming majority of platform assets remain secure and unaffected.

Most importantly, user funds remain protected. 

The incident falls within the coverage of Bitget’s User Protection Fund, which currently holds more than $464 million
